<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/NhlRG0hm04.png</span></p>
<div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="introduction" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Yakamaru is the second boss in the Liberation of Mazcab raid, with up to 10 players in a single encounter. While the fight itself does have many mechanics and sections that require coordination between players, with just a little knowledge and practice and communication between your teammates, it can become a relatively smooth and fun boss encounter.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>This guide aims to cover the basic mechanics of Yakamaru, and cover some of strategies, tips and tricks that will help you get your first kills and beyond. As this is a mechanically intensive group fight with a longer guide, it is broken into a few sections (all linked in the Table of Contents) for easier navigation:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ To see what roles there are and what each one does, see </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Roles at Yakamaru</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ To learn about Yakamaru's attacks and pool mechanics, see </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Auto Attacks</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>, </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Special Attacks</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> and </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Pool Mechanics</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ See </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Fight Overview</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> for a brief description of the fight, and </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Fight Phases</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> for more in-depth information.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">

<span id="presets-and-relics" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Given that Yakamaru is a fairly advanced boss and that its a </nowiki><em><nowiki>group boss</nowiki></em><nowiki>, it is reasonable (and ideal) to have a sufficient level of gear before attempting the boss. </nowiki><strong><nowiki>This helps both make the fight easier and make it easier for you to get into teams.</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>A guideline set of recommendations might this include:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ T80+ power armour + T90+ weapons, perked with </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Starter Perks</nowiki></strong><nowiki> from </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perks</nowiki></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ 95+ Prayer </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="prayer">[[File:Prayer icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>prayer</nowiki>|<nowiki>prayer</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for curses </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="turmoil">[[File:Turmoil.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>turmoil</nowiki>|<nowiki>turmoil</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="anguish">[[File:Anguish.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>anguish</nowiki>|<nowiki>anguish</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="torment">[[File:Torment.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>torment</nowiki>|<nowiki>torment</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="soulsplit">[[File:Soul Split.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>soulsplit</nowiki>|<nowiki>soulsplit</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ 99+ Herblore </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Herblore">[[File:Herblore-icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Herblore</nowiki>|<nowiki>Herblore</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for overloads </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ovl">[[File:Overload (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554436179361864.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ovl</nowiki>|<nowiki>ovl</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="elderovlsalve">[[File:Elder overload salve (6).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>elderovlsalve</nowiki>|<nowiki>elderovlsalve</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Berserker auras </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="berserker">[[File:Berserker aura.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505116347105290.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>berserker</nowiki>|<nowiki>berserker</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reckless">[[File:Reckless aura.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505179378974748.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reckless</nowiki>|<nowiki>reckless</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="mani">[[File:Maniacal aura.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505153709965322.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>mani</nowiki>|<nowiki>mani</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>As always, feel free to adjust the presets according to what you have available.</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=yk1Gpp9iDn0X0xX21oSQ <nowiki>Magic | Basic DPS / Free</nowiki>]<span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;" title="Yakamaru Basic Mage">https://files.catbox.moe/onmwm2.webp<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;font-size:0.85em;">[https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/f5f02637b61fa830cf194c3b6da825cd6705dd9f214f6b170468571881b5fc04.webp Image source]</span></span></p>

</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:540px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://files.catbox.moe/b9rvd3.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;font-size:0.85em;">[https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F0qcPZuWuWeO2UqVkKHy4.png?alt=media Image source]</span></span></p>

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>!familiar</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎for more info.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Melee is not very learner-friendly, and without sufficient gear will lack DPS compared to other styles - </nowiki><strong><nowiki>avoid it if you are a learner, or if a low budget.</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ As Melee, The Zaros Godsword spec </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zgs">[[File:Zaros godsword.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zgs</nowiki>|<nowiki>zgs</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spec">[[File:Weapon Special Attack.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spec</nowiki>|<nowiki>spec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can be used on alternate pools when Berserk </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zerk">[[File:Berserk.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>|<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is on cooldown to increase DPS.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="tank-preset-notes" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Tank Preset Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>This preset is built around survivability</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - the most important thing as a tank is to stay alive - a Reaver </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reaverpouch">[[File:Blood reaver.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reaverpouch</nowiki>|<nowiki>reaverpouch</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="reaverscroll">https://files.catbox.moe/un045k.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1022562484378419284.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> autofiring its scrolls with a short delay can be a significant source of sustain.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Remember to use Prism of Restoration </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="prismofrestoration">https://files.catbox.moe/ac84a0.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> to prevent it from dying.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If this is not sufficient, or you have difficulties using it, a BoB </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="mammothpouch">[[File:Pack mammoth pouch.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1499293961364308059.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>mammothpouch</nowiki>|<nowiki>mammothpouch</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can be an alternative.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Raids armour </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="achtoprimevaltop">[[File:Achto Primeval robe top.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641344704939819028.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>achtoprimevaltop</nowiki>|<nowiki>achtoprimevaltop</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> defensive resets can make tanking a lot easier</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, alternatively Seasingers </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="supseasingersrobetop">[[File:Superior seasinger's robe top.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1501858060010913792.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>supseasingersrobetop</nowiki>|<nowiki>supseasingersrobetop</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, Ganodermic </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ganobody">[[File:Ganodermic poncho.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947805611655208.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ganobody</nowiki>|<nowiki>ganobody</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> etc. will also benefit from using Animate Dead </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="animatedead">[[File:Animate Dead icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>animatedead</nowiki>|<nowiki>animatedead</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> if not owned.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Once you are more comfortable tanking, you can switch to power armour and reduce/avoid shield-camping.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="fight-overview" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Fight Overview</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Yakamaru is the second boss in Liberation of Mazcab raid, fought after Beastmaster Durzag is killed, and the puzzle section afterwards is completed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The loot lock can be reset every 2 days at reset (00:00 UTC)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, but the boss can be fought more often for KC.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This gives no loot, but </nowiki><em><nowiki>does</nowiki></em><nowiki> give chance at pet drops.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Yakamaru fight takes place at the Mazcab beach, where there are 5 pools located.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The arena looks like the following:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/A9OBq6m.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The fight consists of two phases</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Pools phase</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - Yakamaru jumps between different pools using different mechanics and must be killed in each one.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Mirage phase</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - After killing it once in each pool, Yakamaru spawns in all pools simultaneously and must be killed in all the pools and 'closed' permanently, to finish the fight.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ During the pools phase, there will be a special mechanic for each pool - this is covered in the </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Pool Mechanics</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> section.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Yakamaru attacks with auto attacks (Ranged if out of MD, Magic if in MD) and special attacks.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The default attack cycle uses a number of auto attacks followed by a special attack, and then repeats.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The number of autos varies from pool to pool.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>The attack cycle starts at a random point in the cycle</nowiki></em><nowiki> (i.e. Yakamaru could begin with a spec, and then continue from there.)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="roles-at-yakamaru" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Roles at Yakamaru</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>As it is a group fight, a number of players are assigned roles to make the encounter smoother and faster. Here we cover what they are and their basic responsibilities.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>

<div>
<div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255);"></div>
<div>
<div>
<div>

<div><u><nowiki>Yakamaru Roles</nowiki></u>
</div>
<div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>The following roles may be assigned to players at Yakamaru.
Players without a dedicated role are just DPSers.
Roles are roughly sorted by difficulty, for new players.
</nowiki></div>
<div><div><div><u><nowiki>Easy Roles</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ CPR
⬥ Stun 0 (ST0)
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Medium Roles</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Jelly Wrangler (JW)
⬥ Stun 5 (ST5)
⬥ Poison Tank (PT)
⬥ Double
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Advanced Roles</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Base Tank
⬥ North Tank (NT)
⬥ Shark 10 (SH10)
⬥ Main Stun (MS)
</nowiki></div></div></div>
</div>

</div>


</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><strong><nowiki>Note</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: A single player can have more than 1 role, depending on what roles they take.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="base-tank-base" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Base Tank / Base</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tank Yakamaru during each pool until Mirage phase.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tank Tendrils pool during Mirage phase until it is dead.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Other tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Avoid standing near other players, allow them to flank the boss.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Do not die</nowiki></em><nowiki> - prioritise staying alive even at the expense of DPS.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Yakamaru's enrage mechanic affects the base - they will take the most damage during the fight.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This role can help do more DPS on faster teams, or go full tank/shield camp route. This depends on the player and expected killtimes for the team. </nowiki><em><nowiki>If in doubt - focus on surviving.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="poison-tank-pt" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Poison Tank / PT</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand on the correct tile and absorb the poison that Yakamaru spawns after each pool reaches 100k HP left.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move into MD of Yakamaru after absorbing poison, then help defeat the pool.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The tile the poison will land on looks is indicated by </nowiki><em><nowiki>green arrows</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There is no poison to absorb during Mirage phase - only during the first phase with the 4 pools.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bladed Dive </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bd">[[File:Bladed Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bd</nowiki>|<nowiki>bd</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> helps get to the poison ASAP, and Barge </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="barge">[[File:Barge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>barge</nowiki>|<nowiki>barge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can be used to get into MD quickly and consistently.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Teams will typically assign a </nowiki><em><nowiki>Double</nowiki></em><nowiki> role - if the first pool is </nowiki><em><nowiki>not</nowiki></em><nowiki> Stun pool, then the Double will absorb the poison required for stun pool </nowiki><em><nowiki>during the sand pool's poison</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This is to save time and lower chances of failing poison on Stun pool as it can die very quickly.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If this happens, the Poison Tank only ends up absorbing 3 sets of poison instead of 4.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After a successful pool, the PT will be washed up on the beach near the south. </nowiki><em><nowiki>The CPR role is expected to revive the player in time</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="north-tank-nt" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>North Tank / NT</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tank Sand pool (and also usually Stun pool) during Mirage phase until the other 3 pools are dead.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Stand </nowiki><em><nowiki>north</nowiki></em><nowiki> of the pool when tanking it.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ To aggro both pools: tag Sand pool, then use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on Stun pool.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Sand pool is almost always the last to die during Mirage phase</nowiki></em><nowiki> - on slower teams, this can be a tank test. Use defensives if you have to.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Jellies may spawn while tanking the pool - dodge them and let the Jelly Wrangler handle them, or freeze/stun them and move away.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="cpr" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>CPR</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Click on the washed-up player on the beach after each pool to prevent them being instakilled.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once Mirage phase starts, there are no more players to revive.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="double" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Double</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Absorb poison on the Sand pool and take the place of the Poison Tank during Stun pool instead.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The Double will stand on the same tile as the Poison Tank during the Sand pool to do this.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Stand in MD of the Stun pool the entire time</nowiki></em><nowiki>. This is because the Stun pool dies very quickly.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Stun pool is the first pool, this role has no responsibilities.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Be sure to bring extra food to compensate for the extra damage taken, </nowiki><em><nowiki>especially on slower teams</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="main-stun" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Main Stun</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stun Yakamaru </nowiki><em><nowiki>at the appropriate time</nowiki></em><nowiki> during the Stun pool, when his damage reduction is too high.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do NOT accidentally kill the team by stunning too early or multiple times.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A correctly timed stun will only deal 1000 damage to all players, which can rise up to 5000 damage if stunned too early (stun when Yakamaru's health begins to drop very slowly).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is preferred to use non-channeled abilities to stun.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• On newer/inexperienced teams, a warning that you are about to stun may let players eat up before stunning.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="stun-0-st0" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Stun 0 / ST0</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• On Mirage phase, help kill the Stun pool first </nowiki><em><nowiki>ASAP</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Then help kill the other pools in order (Shark &gt; Tendrils &gt; Sand).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This role may not always be assigned, especially on more experienced teams where two Stun 5 roles are sufficient.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If a Stun 5 role dies, you can easily take their place.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Do not randomly use stuns during Mirage phase</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="stun-5-st5" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Stun 5 / ST5</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kill the Stun pool </nowiki><em><nowiki>ASAP</nowiki></em><nowiki> after Mirage phase starts and use </nowiki><em><nowiki>5 planks</nowiki></em><nowiki> on it by clicking on the pool.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Then help kill the other pools in order (Shark &gt; Tendrils &gt; Sand).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Use your strongest abilities to burst the pool down</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pick up your planks </nowiki><em><nowiki>before</nowiki></em><nowiki> Mirage phase starts to make it easier and prevent issues.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Do not randomly use stuns during Mirage phase</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The pool only needs to be tanked for a short amount of time as it dies quickly.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="shark-10-sh10" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Shark 10 / SH10</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tank the Shark pool during Mirage phase, and use </nowiki><em><nowiki>10 planks</nowiki></em><nowiki> on it by clicking the pool after it dies.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand behind the Shark pool to prevent other players from getting enrage stacks.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pick up your planks </nowiki><em><nowiki>before</nowiki></em><nowiki> Mirage phase starts to make it easier and prevent issues (area loot can help).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>If inventory space is an issue, ask another player to help with planks when assigning roles</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Be sure to bring extra food to compensate for the extra damage taken, </nowiki><em><nowiki>especially on slower teams</nowiki></em><nowiki>. Defensives </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> are useful to mitigate damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Setting up an Ultimate ability </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sunshine">[[File:Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zerk">[[File:Berserk.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>|<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deathsswift">[[File:Death's Swiftness.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>|<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> before Mirage phase starts can help make this a lot quicker.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="jelly-wrangler-jw" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Jelly Wrangler / JW</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Primary tasks</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Quickly</nowiki></em><nowiki> tag and aggro all Jellyfish spawned during Mirage phase and keep them away from other players.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep Jellyfish alive after tagging them.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Notable info</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Yakamaru will not attack the Jelly Wrangler if they are attacking Jellies, so praying against Melee </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMelee">[[File:Deflect Melee.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> works</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A maximum of 10 Jellyfish may be alive at once, so avoid killing them.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If JW moves too far away, Jellies will lose aggro, so be careful with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="escape">[[File:Escape.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>escape</nowiki>|<nowiki>escape</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use of Ice Barrage </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="icebarrage">[[File:Ice Barrage icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>icebarrage</nowiki>|<nowiki>icebarrage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or Entangle </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ent">[[File:Entangle icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ent</nowiki>|<nowiki>ent</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can help, as well as the Provoke </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> ability to gain aggro.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep moving around to avoid being surrounded by jellies. Defensives </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> are useful to mitigate damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="auto-attacks" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Auto-attacks</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Yakamaru uses </nowiki><strong><nowiki>AoE auto attacks</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, and the attack style changes based on location:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Within halberd range (≤2 tiles)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Magic attacks</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Outside halberd range (≥3 tiles)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Ranged attacks</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Yakamaru has </nowiki><strong><nowiki>100% hitchance on all auto attacks.</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Attacks that 'miss' deal 50% damage instead.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Each auto-attack on the primary target (base) applies 1 enrage stack ('Drenched' debuff)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This also applies to any player within 7 tiles of the base.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each stack increases damage taken by +20% additively.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Using Freedom </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="freedom">[[File:Freedom.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>|<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> halves the number of stacks.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="jellyfish" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Jellyfish</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Yakamaru spawns Jellyfish of different colours during the fight</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ There are 6 different types of Jellyfish:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Normal/Orange</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: deals melee damage and spawns as part of Yakamaru's 'Jellyfish Spawn' special attack (see </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Special Attacks</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Durable</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: heals other nearby Jellies and Yakamaru while alive.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Magical</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: deals Magic damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Meleefish</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: deals Melee damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Piercing</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: deals Ranged damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Reflecting</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: causes all other Jellies to take less damage, and reflect damage taken onto players - these will die on their own.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Except before Sand Pool and Mirage, first phase Yakamaru in the center pool, </nowiki><em><nowiki>then</nowiki></em><nowiki> kill the colourful jellies.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="special-attacks" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Special Attacks</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>The following 2 special attacks are generic and common to all pools.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Pool-specific special attacks are covered in the </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Pool Mechanics</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> section.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="jellyfish-spawn" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Jellyfish Spawn</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:554px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/qdrWMC0.gif</span><nowiki>
⬥ Yakamaru spawns one orange jellyfish and 5 'cracks' on the floor.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The jellyfish should be killed ASAP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> as it deals high AoE melee damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Standing on the cracks will shortly deal 10000 damage to the jellyfish, but also deal 1500-2000 Magic damage to the player.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Defensives </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> will mitigate this.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Stuns/binds (like </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="icebarrage">[[File:Ice Barrage icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>icebarrage</nowiki>|<nowiki>icebarrage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>) are useful here.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="blue" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Blue</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:571px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/Ncu3Fpt.gif</span><nowiki>
⬥ This attack is typically referred to as '</nowiki><strong><nowiki>blue</nowiki></strong><nowiki>'.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>⬥ A random player will be turned blue (similar to the Metamorphosis </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="meta">[[File:Metamorphosis.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533811304497183.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>meta</nowiki>|<nowiki>meta</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> ability) and take up to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>4 increasing typeless damage hits</nowiki></strong><nowiki> (1500 → 2500 → 3500 → 4500).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Standing next to someone else will pass the effect to them with no damage taken.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Passing it to other players is the recommended way of dealing with it.</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Otherwise, just spam eat.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: If this occurs during mirage phase, it will deal a </nowiki></em><em><nowiki>single hit of 2000 damage</nowiki></em><em><nowiki>, so avoid panicking and running around should it occur to you.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="pool-mechanics" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Pool Mechanics</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Here we go over what each pool at Yakamaru does and how to deal with them. Then we cover the actual fight in the </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Fight Phases</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> section.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="tendrils-pool-south-most" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Tendrils Pool (south-most)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:520px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/l1etI6A.gif</span><nowiki>
⬥ Yakamaru gains access to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>two new special attacks</nowiki></strong><nowiki> (both used at the same time):</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Choking Tendrils</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Yakamaru chokes top 5 DPS, dealing increasing damage per tick. </nowiki><em><nowiki>Players must free themselves by doing damage.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Damage Tendrils</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Summons a large pile of tendrils on Yakamaru's current target that hit 2000 damage per tick for several ticks. Players should move away or use Barricade </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / Immort </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="immort">[[File:Immortality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>immort</nowiki>|<nowiki>immort</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to deal with it.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Attack cycle for this pool is as follows</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 4 autos → Jellyfish → 4 autos → Blue → 4 autos → Tendrils → repeat</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Let the base tag the pool first</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - prevents the Damage Tendrils randomly spawning on the DPS pile.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If poison tank gets choked when poison spawns.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Someone else can get it.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ This pool is relatively straightforward - </nowiki><strong><nowiki>just avoid the tendrils</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and it'll go smoothly.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="shark-pool-south-west" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Shark Pool (south-west)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:596px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/RaWF56G.gif</span><nowiki>
⬥ Yakamaru gains access to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>one new special attack</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Sharknado</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Yakamaru spins in a whirlpool and throws out sharks on the floor randomly, which explode for 2k damage </nowiki><em><nowiki>each</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Attack cycle for this pool is as follows</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 4 autos → Jellyfish → 4 autos → Blue → 4 autos → Sharknado → repeat</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Sharks can be clicked to kick them away, or simply move away from them.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The sharks spawned are blocking</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - be careful of getting stuck!</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The poison tank should be careful and use Barricade </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> if necessary, if Sharknado occurs during the last 100k HP.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can also be helpful when basing or getting hit by multiple sharks.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Note that sharks will follow the player while being thrown out - </nowiki><strong><nowiki>move away from the sharks </nowiki><ins><nowiki>after</nowiki></ins><nowiki> they have landed</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ A Jellyfish will spawn</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ This pool is relatively straightforward - just avoid the shark spawns and it'll go smoothly.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="sand-pool-north-west" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Sand Pool **(north-west)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:563px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/NzqhNcQ.gif</span><nowiki>
⬥ Yakamaru gains access to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>one new special attack</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Sand</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: All but 1-2 players are 'sanded'/stuck and cannot move. Players not stuck must rescue others by </nowiki><strong><nowiki>clicking on them</nowiki></strong><nowiki>. If not freed in time, they are instakilled.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Attack cycle for this pool is as follows</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 4 autos → Blue → 4 autos → Jelly → 4 autos → Sand → repeat</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Players </nowiki><strong><nowiki>can</nowiki></strong><nowiki> continue to eat, attack targets, etc. while sanded, but cannot move.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If Yakamaru is about to sand, </nowiki><em><nowiki>delay phasing it to 100k HP</nowiki></em><nowiki> to ensure the Poison Tank does not get stuck and miss poison.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ One person should go and free the base ASAP as they are usually stuck further away.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ As long as players don't panic, and click on each other to be freed, this pool can be finished quickly. </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Just don't miss the poison.</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="stun-pool-north-most" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Stun Pool (north-most)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: If using Revo/Revo++, remove all stuns from your bar!</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/wPhGTHF.gif</span><nowiki>
⬥ Yakamaru gains access to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>two new mechanics</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Defence Gain</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Yakamaru takes reduced damage as players continue to attack him. This must be reset by stunning him.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Stun Reflect Damage</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: When Yakamaru is stunned, he reflects 1000-5000 typeless damage to </nowiki><em><nowiki>all</nowiki></em><nowiki> players on the team.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Attack cycle for this pool is as follows</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 6 autos → Blue → 7 autos → Jelly → repeat</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The damage from stunning The higher his damage reduction, the less the reflected damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>In other words, don't stun him more than once quickly</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Multi-hit abilities like Asphyxiate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="asphyx">[[File:Asphyxiate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>asphyx</nowiki>|<nowiki>asphyx</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / Destroy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="destroy">[[File:Destroy.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>destroy</nowiki>|<nowiki>destroy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> will almost certainly wipe your team.</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Damage ranges from 1000 (lowest) to 5000 (highest).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Yakamaru takes increased damage this pool, and poison can be easily missed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Assigning a Double to take double poison on Sand pool is </nowiki><em><nowiki>strongly</nowiki></em><nowiki> recommended.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The following count as stuns</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Impact </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="impact">[[File:Impact.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>impact</nowiki>|<nowiki>impact</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / Deep Impact </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deep">[[File:Deep Impact.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833139912724.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deep</nowiki>|<nowiki>deep</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / Asphyxiate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="asphyx">[[File:Asphyxiate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>asphyx</nowiki>|<nowiki>asphyx</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / Shock </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="shock">[[File:Shock.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809932697610.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>shock</nowiki>|<nowiki>shock</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / Horror </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="horror">[[File:Horror.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833261547520.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>horror</nowiki>|<nowiki>horror</nowiki>]]</span></p>
