<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Binding Shot </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bindingshot">[[File:Binding Shot.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306563231790.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bindingshot</nowiki>|<nowiki>bindingshot</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / Tight Bindings </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="tight">[[File:Tight Bindings.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541275957657600.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>tight</nowiki>|<nowiki>tight</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / Rout </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="rout">[[File:Rout.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259268521994.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>rout</nowiki>|<nowiki>rout</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / Demoralise </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="demoralise">[[File:Demoralise.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258559553546.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>demoralise</nowiki>|<nowiki>demoralise</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Backhand </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="backhand">[[File:Backhand.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854302605333.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>backhand</nowiki>|<nowiki>backhand</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / F. Backhand </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="fbackhand">[[File:Forceful Backhand.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879346794516.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>fbackhand</nowiki>|<nowiki>fbackhand</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / Destroy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="destroy">[[File:Destroy.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>destroy</nowiki>|<nowiki>destroy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / Stomp </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="stomp">[[File:Stomp icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879552315412.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>stomp</nowiki>|<nowiki>stomp</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / Kick </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="kick">[[File:Kick.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879132885025.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>kick</nowiki>|<nowiki>kick</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The following do </nowiki><ins><nowiki>not</nowiki></ins><nowiki> count as stuns:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rapid Fire </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="rapid">[[File:Rapid Fire.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>rapid</nowiki>|<nowiki>rapid</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (Greater) Barge </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gbarge">[[File:Greater Barge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>|<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="barge">[[File:Barge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>barge</nowiki>|<nowiki>barge</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ice Spells </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="icebarrage">[[File:Ice Barrage icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>icebarrage</nowiki>|<nowiki>icebarrage</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dreadnips </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nip">[[File:Dreadnip.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537336877900890135.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nip</nowiki>|<nowiki>nip</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dominion Gloves </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spellcaster">[[File:Spellcaster gloves.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643214402169864213.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spellcaster</nowiki>|<nowiki>spellcaster</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="goliathgloves">https://files.catbox.moe/0zc4qd.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1030084069939232778.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="swiftgloves">https://files.catbox.moe/bz7zw6.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023132419597008906.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="fight-phases" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Fight Phases</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>In this section we go over how the fight flows, general recommendations/rotations for DPS, and so on. It is broadly broken up into </nowiki><strong><nowiki>two phases</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: pools phase (i.e. before mirage) and mirage phase.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="phase-1-pools" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Phase 1 - Pools</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Start the fight. Yakamaru will start in the middle pool.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Reduce Yakamaru's health in the center pool to 800k using thresholds, making him randomly choose the first pool to jump to.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Fight Yakamaru in the new pool and reduce his health to 100k</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If your ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sunshine">[[File:Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zerk">[[File:Berserk.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>|<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deathsswift">[[File:Death's Swiftness.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>|<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is available you can use it, assuming you're not saving it for anything else.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If cannot ult (due to cooldown or adren issues), use thresholds/strong specs to help phase.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When he does special attacks, or spawns jellies, deal with them if needed before attacking Yakamaru again.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>At 100k health left, Yakamaru spawns a 'poison' that a player must absorb and then stand in MD of Yakamaru</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, then players will finish off Yakamaru to 0 HP.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>If this is missed, the pool will not advance</nowiki></em><nowiki> and must be re-completed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Yakamaru will jump back to the middle pool. </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Phase the middle pool (200k damage) while Yakamaru is still green</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, </nowiki><em><nowiki>then</nowiki></em><nowiki> focus on Jellies.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place dominion mines if you brought them at this point to help with the Jellies.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The following image shows where roughly where to stand during pools:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/HCiIUtO.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Repeat the above process until all 4 pools have been dealt with.</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The first pool is random, but after that it is always in the following order:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sand Pool → Stun Pool</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stun Pool → Tendrils Pool</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tendrils Pool → Shark Pool</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Shark Pool → Sand Pool</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="phase-2-mirage" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Phase 2 - Mirage</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ This is a </nowiki><em><nowiki>fast-paced phase</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ After Yakamaru returns to the middle after the 4th pool, </nowiki><strong><nowiki>prepare for mirage phase</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stun 5 and Shark 10 roles should pick up their planks.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Poison tank should be revived.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Base and Northtank should get ready to tank their pools.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• On less experienced teams: kill all remaining Jellies.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Begin by reducing Yakamaru's health in the middle pool to 50k HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All 4 pools will again simultaneously spawn with 150k HP each.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They must all be killed and the </nowiki><em><nowiki>pools must be closed by spam clicking the pools after clearing them</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>At this point, the Jelly Wrangler begins tagging and provoking jellies off the rest of the team.</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The following image shows where to stand when mirage starts:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/KWDTNoa.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>⬥ Usual kill order for pools is: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Stun → Shark → Tendrils → Sand</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Base Tank</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: voke Tendrils pool and run south and tank the pool until it is dead and help close it, then follow along with the DPSers</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Stun 0/Stun 5</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: use strong thresholds/special attacks to kill the pool quickly and close with 10 planks, then help DPSers after it is closed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>North Tank</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: voke Sand pool and run </nowiki><em><nowiki>north</nowiki></em><nowiki>, and tank the pool until the other pools are dead and team comes to help kill and close pool.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Shark 10</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: voke Shark pool and stay away from DPS; use your ultimate as mirage starts to help make the process quicker, and join the DPSers after it is closed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>All other players</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use your ultimates (if available) before mirage starts and help kill and close Tendrils pool.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Then finish off Shark pool (ultimate should still be up) and move to Sand pool.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kill Sand pool and help close it.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Finally Yakamaru will respawn with 50k HP in the middle pool, and can be killed to finish the fight.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="general-tips-for-mirage-phase" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>General Tips for Mirage Phase</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>DPSers (i.e. players with no other roles) should try to drop their ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sunshine">[[File:Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zerk">[[File:Berserk.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>|<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deathsswift">[[File:Death's Swiftness.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>|<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="adrenrenewal">[[File:Adrenaline renewal potion (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>|<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as the phase starts</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ideally near </nowiki><em><nowiki>both</nowiki></em><nowiki> the Tendrils and Shark pools.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This lets them attack both pools from their ultimate.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Players focused on tanking a pool should make use of Resonance </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, Debilitate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="debil">[[File:Debilitate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>debil</nowiki>|<nowiki>debil</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, Freedom </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="freedom">[[File:Freedom.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>|<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and Devotion </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to help reduce incoming damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><em><nowiki>Except the North tank</nowiki></em><nowiki>, prefer to avoid camping shields and focus on damage.</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Faster phase → less mechanics → easier kill.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Ignore Jellies - let the Jelly Wrangler focus on them</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Tips for Jelly Wranglers:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep Camera zoomed out and pay attention to other players.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use of binding spells </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="icebarrage">[[File:Ice Barrage icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>icebarrage</nowiki>|<nowiki>icebarrage</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ent">[[File:Entangle icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ent</nowiki>|<nowiki>ent</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can be helpful as well as the </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> ability.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep the Jellies away from other players - going east of the middle pool after aggro'ing all jellies is a good option.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
